case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your quick and complete quotation for the SH-220 stainless pump shaft, and for your clear interest in a long-term partnership. We appreciate it.

Having reviewed your offer, we need the commercial terms to move closer to our expectations before we can award this position. Rather than a single counter, we have prepared options so you can choose the structure that suits you best:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.15; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 13.74; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 14.10; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.

Each option is a genuine route to an award. Option B keeps your payment term unchanged, while Option A offers longer payment in exchange for a slightly different price. We look forward to your choice.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:

message.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
To be fully transparent with you:
We appreciate the options provided; however, changing to DAP and reducing the lead time to 35 days would add significant freight and production costs, increasing the price above our initial offer.
To help you reach your commercial expectations, we propose maintaining the original terms of EXW and a 45-day lead time.
On this basis, we are pleased to offer a reduced price of EUR 15.50 per unit.
Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 45 days and delivery EXW: €15.50 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
